title: Best Gifts Under £20 (2026)
short: Eleven gift ideas under £20, picked from our research-based buying guides, covering car care, cosy gifts, tech and kitchen.
intro: Under £20 is the sweet spot for Secret Santa, colleagues and small thank-yous. Each idea below comes from one of our full buying guides, rated well by independent testers, with a quoted price of £20 or less. Spending less? See [gifts under £10](/gifts-under-10/). Happy to go higher? Try [gifts under £30](/gifts-under-30/).
